posts.text: During a confirmation hearing, Trump’s nominees for judicial roles were unable to answer the same question given to each of them by Sen. Blumenthal.  The reaction suggested that these nominees are afraid of upsetting President Trump with their answer.

Erika Kirk was a guest at a podcast right after the White House Correspondents Dinner incident, and was able to talk about the effects that dehumanizing others has on those people and her husband.  She was so close, but missed the point.

Secretary of defense, Pete Hegseth testified before Congress about the Iran war. While trying to convince Congress that the war must continue indefinitely, and that the military needs more money, Pete Hegseth used the worst example of three wars: Iraq, Afghanistan, and Vietnam. Three of the longest, most expensive and least successful wars fought by the United States. Is this the best example he could find?

When people say “no due process coming in, no due process going out” about undocumented migrants, they show a misunderstanding of how the constitution works.  Being in the United States unlawfully has nothing to do with due process, but defending yourself against a government accusation has everything to do with it.  Let’s fact check @Sarah Sizzle and her claim about immigration.

The war in Iran has hit the 60 day mark. The federal law under the “war Powers resolution“ act says that President Trump cannot continue the war without congressional approval after this point So… What happens after that?

Donald Trump's net worth has increased to more than $6 billion since his last inauguration, mostly from digital assets, and he and Congress continue to benefit from the absence of federal laws on digital assets. It's time for Congress to step in.

The Supreme Court issued a ruling ordering Louisiana to redraw its congressional district maps and redefining section 2 of the voting rights act, which has been historically used to prevent racial discrimination and to challenge congressional maps that are drawn to silence minority voices.

What happened at the White House correspondents dinner is inexcusable, but many are saying that President Trump has been in peril more than Obama. Let’s fact check this.  Responding to @thevaniekay2.0

While campaigning for governor of Ohio, Vivek Ramaswamy talked about his opponents, Dr. Aimee Acton by saying that she “does nothing but complain about her past”, referring to past trauma that Dr. Acton endured and had no control over

President Trump fired the entire national science board. All 24 members of the national science board received a communication saying they were dismissed effective immediately in a move that has never happened in the 75 year history of the board.  The NSB is entrusted with overseeing how billions of dollars in US science funding are prioritized based on merit and objective value.
